_about: Freshness steps (the user, 2026-10-21; docs/FEATURES.md): 90 s time shown, 5 min struck through + grey, 20 min no value
('no readings' + its icon), 3 h no chart. Every glucose surface takes its look from ONE function per platform
(Android graph/Freshness.kt Freshness.look, Mac SukraraGraph.swift Freshness.look), asked through GlucoseCard.face.
FreshnessFixtureTest and Sukrara -graphselftest run every case through the shared function, the card AND every glyph
surface of the one registry, ../surfaces/surfaces.json (each platform has one adapter per glyph surface id; a surface
without one fails). tools/check (card-surface, card-api, card-text) holds the registered files to it.
A case: age (s since the reading, null = no reading), sgv, rate (null = no trend), ended (the sensor is past its end).
expect: state value|no_readings|none|ended, text (null = no value), strike (also grey), trend arrow|none|null
ended (#3; absent = false): a value whose sensor is past its end while its readings keep arriving (fresh or late): the
value stays, with the 'Ended · Replace sensor' pill (whether a reading is valid is the sensor's call, and the alerts act
on it); once they stop (from 5 min, when the value would be struck) the state is ended: 'Sensor ended' + 'Replace sensor'.
(none = the 'no trend' ring), time (the reading's time shown; a fresh value shows none, no 'now' either: the PoC's
look, the owner in #181), graph (the chart shown).
graph_only: what a card WITHOUT a value (graph-only: the graph widgets) shows, so its age is never hidden (the
user's safety review 2026-10-27, Android widgets major #1): time = the reading's time in a label over the chart's
top at EVERY age, fresh too (G2 review 2026-10-27: a widget drawn while fresh that the launcher stops redrawing must
still say when its data is from); none = no label (only a card WITH a value); dimmed = the chart dimmed (grey) plus the time label (from 5 min, the step
where a value is struck through); no_readings = dimmed plus the 'no readings' icon before the time (from 20 min, the
step where a value is hidden); face = no chart, the value's face takes its place (from 3 h / no reading).

steps._about: A reading at 0, then nothing: the times (s) at which every surface must redraw by itself (Freshness.nextChangeAt): the steps, then the time text gaining the day (12 h) and turning into the date (6 days).

_about: What the reading's time says on every surface (Freshness.timeText, decided by Freshness.timeKind on both platforms):
time = the clock time alone ('7:14 AM') while it is today's and at most 12 h old; day = the weekday with it ('Tue
7:14 AM') from 12 h or on another day, since a bare clock time a day later reads as today's; date = the date ('12 Oct')
after 6 days. A case: age (s before now; negative = ahead, a sensor's Ready at), optional now (epoch s, default the
file's: Friday 15 Jan 2027 20:00 UTC); zone UTC.

cases.name: sensor ended, readings keep arriving: the value with the ended flag
sensor ended, late reading: still the value with the flag
sensor ended, readings stopped (struck from 5 min): Sensor ended
sensor ended, no reading at all
